title: Quantization from Scratch
blurb: Implement the main ways to shrink a model: affine codes, group-wise int4 with protected channels, SmoothQuant, GPTQ, NF4 and a quantised KV cache.
intro: Quantisation trades a little accuracy for much less memory and bandwidth. The steps build the formats and algorithms in order of sophistication: affine quantisation with a zero point, group-wise 4-bit weights that keep salient channels in full precision, SmoothQuant's migration of activation outliers into weights, GPTQ's column-by-column error feedback, NF4's normal-quantile levels, and the size of a quantised KV cache. The capstone quantises a small MLP four ways and compares output error against storage.

steps.name: GPTQ: error feedback column by column
